missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Обстановка' is the feminine nominative subject. 'Спокойная' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'в стране' gives the location. A natural way to describe conditions.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Обстановку' is the accusative direct object of 'изучаем'. 'Внимательно' is an adverb of manner. Useful for analysis and assessment.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'из-за'. The preposition 'из-за' takes the genitive 'обстановки' to mark the cause. 'Сложной' agrees in the feminine genitive. A reusable cause-and-effect pattern.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Об обстановке' uses the prepositional 'обстановке' after 'о' to mean talking about it. 'Текущей' agrees in the feminine prepositional. Common in discussion.

Strategic focus: Nominative subject with dative experiencer. 'Обстановка' is the nominative thing that pleases. 'Нам' is the dative experiencer and 'нравится' agrees with the subject. A reusable preference frame.

Strategic focus: Accusative object in the furnishings sense. 'Обстановку' is the accusative object of 'купили', here meaning furniture. 'Новую' agrees in the feminine accusative. Shows the second meaning of the word.
Strategic focus: Dative after 'к'. The verb 'привыкнуть к' takes the dative 'обстановке' to mean getting used to it. 'Напряжённой' agrees in the feminine dative. Models adapting to conditions.

Strategic focus: Instrumental after a short adjective. 'Недовольны' governs the instrumental 'обстановкой' to express dissatisfaction. 'Такой' agrees in the feminine instrumental. A reusable complaint pattern.

Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Обстановки' is the nominative plural subject of 'отличаются'. 'В разных регионах' is a prepositional plural phrase. Practises plural agreement of an abstract noun.

Strategic focus: Genitive after 'без'. The preposition 'без' takes the genitive 'обстановки' to mean without it. 'Спокойной' agrees in the feminine genitive, and 'трудно' frames the difficulty. A practical sentence.
